title: Church news: the News page on the phone (your steer)
question: Following your steer: the newest post leads with its picture like a front page, the rest are rows with their picture at the side, and a Your ministries tab shows the combined news of every ministry you're in (it isn't there for someone in no ministry). Three ways to put that together; the next two rounds (reading one post, and writing one) follow straight after.

options.label: Tabs under the masthead, pictures at the left
options.thesis: The church and Your ministries as the app's underline tabs, sticky under the top bar; the lead post's picture runs the width, then rows with a square picture at the left and From … under each.
materials: sticky underline tabs with a count
options.viewport: Scrolled a little: Your ministries chosen (3 new), the lead post from Youth, then rows from Kids ministry and Music, each with its picture at the left.
options.risk: A row with no picture loses its left edge alignment, so posts without one sit flush with the text column.

options.label: A lead, two side by side, then rows
options.thesis: Like a newspaper's front: the lead post wide, the next two posts with pictures side by side, then the rest as rows with their picture at the right.
materials: rows with pictures at the right
options.viewport: The church chosen: the Christmas lead, Baptisms and Youth camp side by side, then Holiday program volunteers as a row.
options.risk: The pair needs two posts with pictures near the top; with fewer it falls back to rows, so the page changes shape week to week.

options.label: What's urgent today first, then the lead
options.thesis: A post sent as urgent today sits above everything on a marker band; then the lead post with its picture, then rows with the picture at the right.
materials: marker band for today's urgent post
rows with pictures at the right
options.viewport: The church chosen: Building works (Today) on the marker band, the Christmas lead, then Baptisms as a row with its picture at the right.
options.risk: An urgent post leaves the band at the end of its day, so it moves down the list overnight.
